description: All-in-one installer for Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable runtimes (x86 and x64), including legacy runtimes and the current 2022/2026 packages.
notes: To install the Visual C++ runtimes, run Installer.cmd from the extracted package as administrator. This changes system-wide runtimes; the upstream installer may remove existing non-compliant versions before installing, and Scoop uninstall does not remove the installed runtimes.
